parsed_output.email_body:
Dear Ilia Beauty Team,

I hope this email finds you well. As a brand that emphasizes clean beauty principles and sustainable skincare practices, we believe there is a great opportunity to engage your audience further through a collaborative Instagram post. We propose a behind-the-scenes look at the creation of a new product line, from concept to final product. This post would not only showcase your commitment to clean beauty but also highlight the unique qualities of your products, such as their safety, effectiveness, and natural ingredients.

We believe this initiative would help reach a wider audience and further engage your target audience.

Looking forward to your thoughts on this proposal.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
